list.name: contratista
list.label: Contratista
list.query: SELECT id as __value, razon_social as __text FROM contratistas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY razon_social

list.name: area
list.label: Área
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM areas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

list.name: proceso
list.label: Proceso
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM procesos WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR area_id IN (${area:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

targets.rawSql: SELECT ep.nombre AS etapa, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS total FROM historial_etapas h JOIN expedientes e ON h.expediente_id = e.id JOIN etapas_proceso ep ON h.etapa_id = ep.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) GROUP BY ep.nombre ORDER BY MIN(h.orden)

SELECT ep.nombre AS etapa, COUNT(*) AS stuck, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - e.fecha_creacion)) / 86400) AS promedio_dias FROM expedientes e JOIN etapas_proceso ep ON e.etapa_actual_id = ep.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (ep.tipo_etapa != 'final' OR ep.es_final = false) AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) GROUP BY ep.nombre ORDER BY stuck DESC

SELECT ep.nombre AS etapa, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.accion = 'rechazar') AS rechazados, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.accion = 'rechazar')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) AS tasa_rechazo_pct FROM historial_etapas h JOIN expedientes e ON h.expediente_id = e.id JOIN etapas_proceso ep ON h.etapa_id = ep.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) GROUP BY ep.nombre ORDER BY tasa_rechazo_pct DESC
SELECT accion, entidad, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS usuarios_distintos FROM audit_events WHERE accion IN ('ADVANCE', 'REJECT') GROUP BY accion, entidad ORDER BY total DESC
